groups.title: Textured a: big station, big farm, town hall, small farm, quarry, house
groups.note: NEW LANE: art/textured-a does not exist on origin yet. The sub-agent creates it from origin/develop (worktree add -b codex-textured-a G:/DEV/wt/codex-textured-a origin/develop; the first push of HEAD:art/textured-a creates the branch). Inputs: the textured renders on claude/art-scaffolds-review-2 (assets/source/buildings-v2/scaffolds-textured/) and the original paintings (the prompt says where each lives). Accepted pictures go to assets/source/textured/<building>/<building>-r<v>.png. Stricter tests than the scaffold prompts (IoU 0.92, p95 16, max 32 canvas px, height 8 per cent; oil derrick IoU 0.88). Stop rule per building (two consecutive views with all 3 attempts under IoU 0.80 stops THAT building, the group goes on). Prompts with status blocked or superseded are skipped.
